evidenceBoundary: Ground benchmarks only. SAR maritime is the primary benchmark candidate, wildfire and change is secondary, and optical quality is a control workload. The flight workload still requires customer and measured benchmark evidence.

workloads.name: SAR maritime vessel detection and scene prioritization
workloads.plainLanguage: Find vessels in radar imagery and return compact detections plus selected image chips for review.
workloads.roleExplanation: Program priority. One image does not establish identity, intent, or illegal activity; activity cues require temporal, AIS, RF, or other corroborating context.
workloads.decision: Return georeferenced vessel detections and priority image chips before full-scene delivery
workloads.customerQuestion: Which vessels or maritime scenes need immediate review?

workloads.name: Wildfire, burn-scar, and change detection
workloads.plainLanguage: Flag new fires and meaningful land changes, then return coordinates and priority regions first.
workloads.roleExplanation: Secondary application. It remains available if data rights, customer need, and measured performance support it.
workloads.signal: Optical imagery from a live mission data path
workloads.decision: Prioritize detections and changed areas for time-sensitive delivery
workloads.customerQuestion: Which new scenes and regions warrant immediate analyst attention?

workloads.name: Optical cloud and quality screening
workloads.plainLanguage: Identify cloud-covered, blurred, or otherwise unusable optical scenes before bulk delivery.
workloads.roleExplanation: Control benchmark. It validates ingestion, preprocessing, telemetry, and measurement but does not justify 10 kW by itself.
workloads.decision: Keep, reprioritize, or discard a scene before raw-data downlink
workloads.customerQuestion: Can this scene support the intended downstream analysis?
